content: Bundled binary assets (images/PDFs) can dominate APK/IPA size; best practice is compressing assets before bundling, using flutter build apk --analyze-size to audit, and deferred/lazy loading for content not needed at first launch. For a small number of PDFs (single burdah at v1, more added later), bundling as assets is fine but the pattern should support fetching/adding new burdah PDFs without bloating the base install as the library grows.
